TEST INPUT AND EVIDENCE RULE (TermAl and Engram). This is ONE current entry: replace it, don't append history.

Greg, directly to Termal::Fable2 on 2026-10-31 (verbatim): „test run musi miec czysty branch z commitem, tyle"; „czystosc brancha moze byc problemem / mozemy dodac, ale wazne sa reguly gitignore / rozumiem, ze probujemy wykryc ew probe modyfikacji przez innego agenta"; „przed test-runem jakis "brud" => fail / po testach czysty => OK / po testak brudno => agent makes a call, poniewaz to moge byc jakies drobne smieci, szkoda by odrzucac caly gate"; „zgadzam sie z doprecyzowaniem, ma sens". Via Advisor (#2827): „nikt nie robi dodatkowych czekow z test-runami. czysty branch z danym commitem i tyle... nic wiecej nie jest potrzebne".

RULE
- A test's input is a clean checkout of a named commit. "Clean" means a plain `git status` that respects .gitignore; ignored build outputs and dependencies don't count.
- Dirty before the run ⇒ FAIL (the run doesn't start). Clean after ⇒ OK. Dirty after ⇒ the responsible agent decides, and that decision is RECORDED with the run: the dirty paths and why they're harmless. A tracked source change can never be waved through.
- The evidence counts for an item when the evaluated or landed commit is the tested commit. No named-root sightings, no captures, no extra measurements or hashes, and no manual agent steps. The tools check automatically at existing points.
- The existing staged-tree gate-then-commit lane stays separate (its tested input is the staged tree), until Greg chooses between A (keep it) and B (commit first on a worker branch).

DESIGN: TermAl w-decd61d62831 note d37458f9 = shared w-a08b0320448f note 8acfd132 = Engram w-d7826c4f78ec note 85d00625. The debris-disposition annex is TermAl 424726f1 = Engram 1ab57d78. Any authority wording goes through the normal instruction-change process; until then, the current landing instructions apply.

STATUS: w-779e (capture) is PAUSED and superseded. Engram w-8fdd, w-7b19 and w-00e2 are parked. BarA2 implements the TermAl side in w-decd; Engram assigns the coder for the OFF result producer and the evaluation change.
